cardArt.title: The American Express Qantas Business Rewards Card

product.description: The American Express Qantas Business Rewards Card - the Business Card that moves with you. Earn Qantas Points on your Business spend

eligibility.additionalInfo: Long term visa means 12 months or more and does not include a student visa.
eligibility.additionalValue: You are an Australian citizen or permanent resident or hold a long term visa.

eligibility.additionalInfo: Employee Card Members must be over 18 years of age. The Business and the Primary Card Member are jointly and severally liable for all Employee Card spending. Each employee is entitled to only one (1) Employee Card.
Must be a Director or Controller of the business
Applications are assessed based on the information provided and are subject to credit approval.

features.additionalInfo: No fee for up to 99 Employee Cards.
The Amex App lets you quickly and easily manage your Card Account anytime, anywhere.
Fraud Protection Guarantee, protecting you from unauthorised charges made on your Account.
Terms, conditions, cover limits and exclusions apply.

Earn up to 4 Qantas Points per $1 spent:
2 Qantas Points per $1 spent on eligible Qantas products and services when you pay with your Card, plus 2 bonus Qantas Points per $1 spent on eligible Qantas flights once all segments in a flight booking have been flown.
1.25 Qantas Points on everyday business spend, except spend at government, utilities & insurance in Australia where you'll get 0.5 Qantas Points per $1 spent.
After a total of 500,000 Qantas Points is earned in a calendar year, the everyday business earn rate will change from 1.25 to 0.75 Qantas Point per $1 spent.

Enjoy exciting offers and deals with Amex Offers that add value to your Card Membership. Amex Offers must be saved to the Card and used for qualifying spend, subject to offer-specific criteria, to receive a benefit.
Get pre-sale tickets and access to some of your favourite events, and enjoy the Amex Entertainment Lounge before the show at select venues. With Amex, you can dive into unforgettable experiences.
Optimise your cash flow by choosing to pay off a portion of your balance, up to your FPO limit, over time. Subject to interest.
With up to 51 days to pay for purchases, you can give your business the financial breathing room to take greater control of your cash flow.
features.additionalValue: Extend your cash flow by up to 51 days

features.additionalInfo: Make your Travel more Comfortable with Complimentary Lounge Access. With two complimentary domestic Qantas Club lounge passes annually, you can unwind before your flight after your first spend on selected Qantas products or services.

Welcome to the best of both worlds with your complimentary membership to the Qantas Business Rewards program. You can earn Qantas Points for your business with American Express and other Qantas Business Rewards Partners, while saving up to 10% on eligible Qantas flights.
Your American Express Qantas Business Rewards Card has flexible spending power, also known as no pre-set spending limit, because it is a Charge Card

fees.additionalInfo: $0 annual Employee Card fee for up to 99 cards (this limit includes both active and cancelled Employee Cards).
fees.name: Business Employee Card Fee

discounts.description: American Express may, at its discretion, discount the annual fee where the customer holds an eligible American Express Personal Card and meets all other applicable eligibility criteria.

eligibility.additionalInfo: Offer only available to Card Members who hold and continue to hold a full‑fee Qantas American Express Ultimate Card and meet all other applicable eligibility criteria.

discounts.description: American Express may, at its discretion, discount the annual fee to new Card Members who are American Express accepting Merchants and meet all other applicable eligibility criteria.

eligibility.additionalInfo: Offer only available to new Card Members who are American Express accepting Merchants at the time of application and approval, continue to accept American Express and do not breach their Card acceptance agreement, and have not held any other American Express Business Card in the past 18 months.

fees.additionalInfo: Three percent (3%) or $20, whichever is greater, will be charged on any overdue amount.
fees.additionalValue: When you do not pay the minimum payment required by the due date as shown on your statement.
fees.name: Late Payment Fee

fees.additionalInfo: 3.5% of the converted amount. Payable when any charge is processed in a currency other than Australian dollars.
fees.name: Currency Conversion Fee

fees.additionalInfo: $20 for each dishonour or debit rejection.
fees.name: Dishonour Fee

fees.additionalInfo: $3 Payable if you pay your Card Account in person at Australia Post by EFTPOS.
fees.name: Over The Counter Fee

fees.additionalInfo: Payable when you or the Employee Card Member requests a copy of an individual charge. $7 for charges in Australia, or $10 for other charges.
fees.name: Record of Charge Fee

lendingRates.additionalInfo: Flexible Payment Option rate applied to the portion of your statement balance carried forward up to your FPO limit.
